original_test_intent: Demonstrate that two correctable errors on the same intended GNR DRAM row reach the runtime threshold and cause BIOS to perform and complete Runtime Soft PPR while the system remains in the runtime flow.
original_method: Record platform/DIMM topology, harness, settings and data-scrambling baseline; apply the source Runtime PPR and threshold matrix; map address0x8000 to one approved row; preserve logs; execute exactly one CE/go and capture 1/2 plus extlog; execute the second identical CE/go and capture threshold, runtime repair and exact extmem_log_event; prove no boot-time reset substituted for runtime action, verify repaired-row/health state, and restore all debug/PPR plus any explicitly approved workaround.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates one-row mapping and any issue#120 workaround, then controls both injections and recovery; agent may correlate threshold, FTrace and runtime-repair evidence.
required_inputs: GNR stepping, BIOS/BMC/OS and DIMM/row identity
Expected 1/2 and reached serial fields, extlog_mem_event, exact extmem_log_event and runtime repair completion fields
Decision whether issue#120 affects this firmware and exact approved scrambling knob/scope/security impact/rollback if required
Crash/OOB recovery, no-retry and final repaired-row health oracle
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated workload-free SUT and approved sacrificial row
Preserve logs/settings and prove both injections hit the same row
Stop if first stage is not CE 1/2 or if any event is wrong severity/row
Do not disable data scrambling from the source note without explicit platform procedure and security approval
Do not reboot to manufacture runtime repair evidence or issue extra injections
Restore all debug/PPR/workaround settings and verify DIMM/OS/BMC health
agent_execution_scope: Observe exactly two approved CE/go stages and collect serial/FTrace/runtime-PPR evidence
Do not choose row, disable scrambling, inject/reboot/retry independently or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Review same-row runtime repair and issue verdict

review_improvement: Restores the exact two-stage runtime repair evidence, preserves the source event token and places the risky data-scrambling workaround behind explicit engineering control.
independent_technical_reasoning: Runtime PPR is proven by timing: the second CE crosses a per-row threshold and firmware repairs the row without relying on a reboot. Both injections must map to the same row; otherwise the 1/2 transition is meaningless. Generic logs cannot show that causal chain. The source note describes a known issue workaround, but turning off scrambling can change protection and address interpretation, so it is neither a default precondition nor an automatic fix.
